why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Michael Harris II is slot #7 (4.588 expected team runs/game).
Slots #7, #8, #6, #9, #5, #4, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #7 yields 4.03 expected PA/game vs 4.35 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models +0.002 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
